# ⚠ NOT the main omp repository

Use **https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi**. That is omp; this repository is not.

## What this is

A small set of patches carried on upstream `can1357/oh-my-pi` release tags. Each patch carries
a test, and each is meant for upstream.

This branch, `fork/main`, is upstream `v18.4.12` plus this notice and the `.fdeck/` patch list.

## Patches

None yet. The list lives in `.fdeck/PATCHES.yaml`.

## No releases, no support, no issues here

Nothing is released from this repository, no support is offered, and issues are disabled.
Report omp problems at https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi.
